dialogues.speaker: Peristerophile Night Raven
dialogues.text: The white wings of the pigeon suspended in flight are lovely to behold indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Peristerophile Night Raven
dialogues.text: W—Wait. What are you doing? How could you do that to the pigeons!?

dialogues.speaker: Peristerophile Night Raven
dialogues.text: Ah, the pigeons, those poor, lovely pigeons...
